name: Silent Current
history: Silent Current fue un grupo activo en 2017, de estilo rock alternativo con influencias de Incubus, Audioslave, Three Doors Down, Audioevent y Foo Fighters.
historyEn: Silent Current was a band active in 2017, of alternative rock style with influences of Incubus, Audioslave, Three Doors Down and Audioevent.
